The missing key is `rate`. `settings.json:2` has it misspelled as `"rat": 0.5`, so `SETTINGS.get("rate")` at `app/pricing.py:8` returns `None`.

`app/config.py:9-10` loads `settings.json` as-is, so nothing corrects the typo. The fix would be to rename `"rat"` to `"rate"` at `settings.json:2`. I haven't changed any files.
